args.lesson: Release preparation took one turn. What worked: copying the repaired sources byte for byte and then running the documented command from a temp copy of the release files only. That proved the downloads reproduce the expected fixture exactly (sha 31c57442...). I also FETCHed the cited help URL, because the saved research text had no source URL. What failed: verify.py is a test-harness library (positional rows), so calling it on DictReader rows raised KeyError. That is disclosed, not hidden. An EXEC that wrote a file with a random name was refused because outputs must be declared exactly, so choose fixed filenames first. Adding the IndexNow key after the first dry_run forced a second digest. Include every planned file before the first dry_run. Deploy waits on an independent APPROVE of 4cab61d1...; downloads have no telemetry, and no revenue is possible without a collection route.
